run_metadata.git_state_scope: captured before generated artefacts were written

ci_method: grouped_bootstrap over dup_group_id (case-level pooled across repeats)

definitions.M1: Baseline ML predict only (max-prob / production decode)
definitions.M2: Importance overlay on M1 (RM9): all-fold permutation + local explanations; classification metrics identical to M1 by design — not a separate predictor
definitions.M5: Monolithic fixed sequence DQ→physics→predict→uncertainty→fuse (no coordinator, no Critic)
definitions.M7: Full multi-agent system with Critic and rechecks

M2.note: RM9 importance overlay (not a separate classifier): metrics ≡ M1. See m2_importance.json (all-fold importances_mean / ranked + local).

M7_minus_M1_qwk.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

M7_minus_M6_qwk.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

M6_minus_M5_qwk.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

M7_minus_M1_severe.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

M7_minus_M6_severe.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

M6_minus_M5_severe.note: Fold-level paired Δ; primary case-level CIs use grouped bootstrap above.

criterion_label_agreement.note: Use to set ml_vs_criteria severity from measured precision (RM5).
criterion_label_agreement.severity_rule: severe when voter agreement ≥ cut; cut = hand 0.75 if consensus-label precision ≥ 0.40 else 1.01 (never)

protocol: held-out fold models only; identical folds across M1–M7; fold fusion kept in memory (no fusion.joblib overwrite); fold-trained ensembles passed to uncertainty

risk_coverage_max_prob_vs_r_final.note: Report served R_final versus M1 max-prob RC areas plainly (RC4); the production feature set is selected by the declared A-D rule.

agent_value_finding.note: Route divergence uses substantive actions only (extra_validation / recheck* / critic). If M5/M6/M7 remain indistinguishable on grades, agents may not change argmax; not tuned on test folds.

matched_coverage.note: Per-system same-coverage comparison: each M3–M7 native accepted subset versus the highest-confidence M1 subset of equal size on the same pooled predictions; paired duplicate-grouped bootstrap CIs.

robustness.protocol: RC6: all outer folds×repeats; fold-trained pipeline+ensemble+conformal; perturb primaries only; metrics vs unperturbed baseline; full mode scores every fold test case (quick caps per fold)

mild.criterion: true only when the bootstrap CI excludes zero

strong.criterion: true only when the bootstrap CI excludes zero

r_final_sensitivity_flag.note: If true after Phase 5 full eval: optional fusion inputs for missingness/perturbation sensitivity, or report honest negative (Phase 6).

strong_vs_mild_note.criterion: primary = degrade vs unperturbed; mild-vs-strong is secondary

missing_data.protocol: RC6: all outer folds×repeats; production-family models; physical masks (σθ+SCF; σc+SCF/B1/B2; σt+B1/B2); physics reconstruction; imputer predict path (median/knn/iterative) + full M7 path
